observations: The PMID:25070544 cohort assessed genomic complexity and neoadjuvant chemotherapy response.

entities.name: PMID:25070544
observations: Retrospective study of 65 synovial sarcoma patients; array-CGH genomic profiling, with 45 receiving neoadjuvant anthracycline/ifosfamide chemotherapy and response evaluated radiologically by RECIST and histologically.

entities.name: No instability-response link
observations: In a 65-patient synovial sarcoma cohort, including 45 treated neoadjuvantly, array-CGH genomic complexity was not significantly associated with radiological RECIST or histological chemotherapy response; genomic complexity was associated with metastasis-free survival.
